# MixoGuide
MixoGuide is a cocktail management and discovery application. Users can browse cocktails, manage a personal ingredient pantry, discover which cocktails they can make with what they have on hand, plan cocktail events, log every making with quantity and date, and rate their favourites. An admin interface provides full CRUD management for all entities.
Built with **Next.js (App Router)**, **React Native (Expo)**, **Prisma**, **PostgreSQL**, **TanStack React Query**, **NextAuth**, and **Tailwind CSS**.
**Documentation:** - [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md) — full technical architecture, data flows, and design decisions - [OAUTH_SETUP.md](./OAUTH_SETUP.md) — mobile Google OAuth setup guide - [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md) — AI agent context (key paths, conventions, common tasks)
---
## Features
| Feature | Description | |---|---| | Cocktail catalogue | Browse, filter, and search hundreds of cocktail recipes | | Ingredient pantry | Track what you own with quantities and units | | Makeable detection | Instantly see which cocktails you can make right now | | Planning | Schedule cocktails for future dates with quantity | | Made-cocktail history | Each making is logged separately — quantity + date, multiple entries per cocktail | | Shopping list | Add missing ingredients directly from a recipe | | Events / Collections | Plan multi-cocktail events with per-serving grocery lists | | Ratings & favourites | Rate cocktails and bookmark your go-tos | | Auth | Email/password + Google OAuth via NextAuth (web + mobile) | | Mobile app | React Native (Expo) app for iOS and Android | | Admin panel | Full CRUD for cocktails, ingredients, glasses, bar tools, and more |
---
## Monorepo Structure
This is a **pnpm workspace** monorepo:
``` MixoGuide/ ├── src/ # Next.js web app (App Router) │ ├── app/ # Route groups: (home), admin │ ├── components/ # Reusable UI components │ ├── hooks/ # React Query hooks (queries/ + mutations/) │ ├── lib/ # query-keys, query-client, env, rateLimit, invalidation │ ├── middlewares/ # withUser, withAdmin, withErrorHandler │ ├── repositories/ # Prisma data access layer │ ├── services/ # Business logic │ └── validations/ # Zod request schemas ├── mobile/ # React Native app (Expo SDK 54) │ ├── app/ # Expo Router screens │ └── src/ # Components, hooks, utilities ├── packages/ │ └── shared/ # Types + Zod auth schemas shared by web and mobile ├── prisma/ # Schema, migrations, seed scripts ├── tests/ # Vitest unit and integration tests ├── e2e/ # Playwright end-to-end tests └── docker-compose.yml # Local PostgreSQL + MinIO ```
---
## Prerequisites
- **Node.js** 20+ - **pnpm** 9+ - **Docker** (for local PostgreSQL and MinIO via `docker-compose`)
---
## Quick Start — Web App
```bash # 1. Start local database and storage docker-compose up -d
# 2. Install dependencies pnpm install
# 3. Configure environment cp .env.example .env # Fill in: DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, AUTH_GOOGLE_ID, AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET
# 4. Run migrations and generate Prisma client pnpm db:migrate pnpm db:generate
# 5. (Optional) Seed with sample data pnpm db:seed
# 6. Start dev server pnpm dev ```
The app will be available at `http://localhost:3000`.
---
## Quick Start — Mobile App
```bash cd mobile pnpm install pnpm start # Start Expo dev server pnpm android # Run on Android emulator ```
See [OAUTH_SETUP.md](./OAUTH_SETUP.md) for Google OAuth configuration on mobile.
---
## Architecture
``` Frontend (React/Next.js) Mobile (React Native/Expo) └─ React Query hooks └─ React Query + Zustand └─ fetch() └─ fetch() └─ /api/* Route Handlers └─ Middleware (withUser / withAdmin / withErrorHandler) └─ Services (business logic) └─ Repositories (Prisma queries) └─ PostgreSQL ```
See [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full architecture documentation including mobile, monorepo structure, data flows, and deployment.
---
## Key Data Models
| Model | Purpose | |---|---| | `User` | Accounts (email + OAuth) | | `Cocktail` | Recipes with ingredients, technique, occasions, flavours | | `Ingredient` | Spirits, mixers, garnishes — with unit + ABV | | `UserPantryItem` | Per-user inventory (pantry + shopping list) | | `PlannedCocktail` | Scheduled future making (one plan per cocktail per user) | | `CocktailMadeLog` | History log — one row per making event, quantity + date, unlimited per cocktail | | `PlannedCollection` | Multi-cocktail party/event planning | | `Rating` | 1–5 star ratings per user per cocktail | | `UserFavoriteCocktail` | Bookmarked cocktails |
### Cocktail Made Log
Every time a cocktail is made (via **"Make now"** or **"Mark as done"**), a `CocktailMadeLog` row is written:
``` CocktailMadeLog { id, userId, cocktailId, quantity, // how many servings were made madeAt, // exact timestamp note // optional free-text note } ```
This replaces the old single `done` state on `PlannedCocktail`. The **"Made"** tab now shows the complete log — a cocktail made five times appears as five separate cards, each with its own date and quantity.
---
## API Reference
### Common query parameters (all `GET /api/{entity}` endpoints)
| Parameter | Example | Description | |---|---|---| | `page` | `?page=2` | Page number (default: 1) | | `limit` | `?limit=50` | Results per page (max: 500) | | `sortBy` | `?sortBy=name` | Sort field | | `sortOrder` | `?sortOrder=asc` | `asc` or `desc` | | `search` | `?search=mojito` | Full-text search | | `include` | `?include=ingredients` | Relations to include | | `filter[field]` | `?filter[difficulty]=easy` | Exact filter | | `filter[field][op]` | `?filter[abv][gte]=20` | Filter with operator (`eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `like`, `between`) |
### Response format
```json { "success": true, "data": [...], "meta": { "total": 150, "page": 1, "limit": 20, "totalPages": 8, "hasNextPage": true, "hasPreviousPage": false } } ```
### Key endpoints
| Method | Path | Description | |---|---|---| | `GET` | `/api/cocktails` | List cocktails (paginated, filterable) | | `GET` | `/api/cocktails/makeable` | Cocktails the user can make from pantry | | `POST` | `/api/cocktails/:id/make` | Make now → pantry decrement + log entry | | `GET` | `/api/cocktail-made-logs` | User's complete making history | | `GET` | `/api/planned-cocktails` | Planned cocktails (filter by `status`) | | `POST` | `/api/planned-cocktails/:id/complete` | Mark as done → pantry decrement + log entry | | `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE` | `/api/user-pantry-items` | Pantry CRUD | | `GET` | `/api/planned-collections/:id/grocery` | Grocery list for a collection | | `GET` | `/api/admin/stats` | Dashboard statistics |
---
## Scripts
### Root (web/api/db)
| Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `npm run dev` | Start Next.js dev server | | `npm run build` | Build for production | | `npm run lint` | ESLint for web source | | `npm run type-check` | TypeScript check | | `npm run db:migrate` | Prisma migrate dev | | `npm run db:migrate:prod` | Prisma migrate deploy | | `npm run db:generate` | Generate Prisma client | | `npm run test:api` | API integration tests only (`tests/integration`, excluding `tests/integration/db/**`) | | `npm run test:db` | Real Postgres DB integration tests (`tests/integration/db/**`) | | `npm run test:coverage:check` | Web/API coverage gate run (excludes DB integration tests) | | `npm run test:webapp` | Playwright E2E suite (`e2e/**`) | | `npm run test:all` | Full local chain: coverage gate + DB integration + Playwright + mobile coverage gate |
### Mobile (`mobile/`)
| Command | Purpose | |---|---| | `npm --prefix mobile run start` | Start Expo dev server | | `npm --prefix mobile run android` | Run Android app | | `npm --prefix mobile run type-check` | TypeScript check | | `npm --prefix mobile run lint` | ESLint | | `npm --prefix mobile run test:coverage:check` | Mobile Jest coverage gate | | `npm --prefix mobile run test:android:smoke` | Local manual Android smoke helper (prints adb/checklist flow) |
---
## Testing
### Coverage thresholds
| Surface | Statements | Branches | Functions | Lines | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Web/API/DB (Vitest) | 90 | 85 | 85 | 90 | | Mobile (Jest) | 85 | 80 | 80 | 85 |
### Test folders and frameworks
```text tests/unit, tests/services, tests/integration -> Vitest tests/integration/db -> Vitest + real Postgres e2e -> Playwright mobile/src/**/__tests__, mobile/app/**/__tests__ -> Jest ```
### Local runbook
```bash # 1) Web/API coverage gates (DB tests excluded on purpose) npm run test:coverage:check
# 2) DB integration (real Postgres) npm run test:db
# 3) Web end-to-end npm run test:webapp
# 4) Mobile coverage gates npm --prefix mobile run test:coverage:check
# Full chain npm run test:all ```
### DB test environment
`test:db` loads `.env.local` first, then `.env`, requires `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, and remaps: - `DATABASE_URL = TEST_DATABASE_URL` - `DIRECT_URL = TEST_DATABASE_URL` (unless already set)
Recommended local setup:
```env # .env DATABASE_URL=<your regular local/dev db> DIRECT_URL=<your regular local/dev db>
# .env.local TEST_DATABASE_URL=<dedicated test database> NEXTAUTH_SECRET=<test/dev secret> ```
### Android smoke
Android smoke is intentionally manual/local, not CI-gated: - checklist: `mobile/scripts/android-smoke-checklist.md` - helper: `npm --prefix mobile run test:android:smoke`
---
## CI pipeline
GitHub Actions workflow: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- `web-ci`: install, Prisma generate, type-check, lint, `npm run test:coverage:check`, upload coverage artifact. - `db-integration`: starts Postgres service, runs Prisma migrate deploy, runs `npm run test:db`. - `mobile-ci`: install in `mobile/`, type-check, lint, `npm run test:coverage:check`, upload mobile coverage artifact.
Note: Playwright (`npm run test:webapp`) is part of local `test:all` but is not currently a CI job in this workflow.
---
## Deployment
The app ships as a **Docker image** (multi-stage build, ~50 MB runtime). The entrypoint runs `prisma migrate deploy` + optional seeding before starting the server.
**Local dev:** `docker-compose.yml` provides PostgreSQL 18 + MinIO (S3-compatible storage). MinIO buckets are auto-bootstrapped on first start.
**Production:** Self-hosted on Hetzner via [Coolify](https://coolify.io). See `COOLIFY_SETUP.sh` for the full provisioning guide.
### Production Ingredient Cleanup
After rebuilding/redeploying the app image, run the compiled production cleanup script from the production container. Preview the merge plan first:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --db ```
If the preview looks good, apply the merge:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --apply ```
Then verify that no configured duplicate ingredient rows remain:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --db ```
The apply step rewires cocktail ingredients, pantry rows, main-alcohol references, barcodes, and derivatives before deleting duplicate ingredient rows.
---
## Conventions
- **One file = one responsibility** — Repository handles data, Service handles business logic, Route handles HTTP - **No Prisma in services** — always go through the repository layer - **No direct DB access from frontend** — all data flows through `/api/*` routes - **Always validate** with Zod before calling the service - **Typed errors** — `NotFoundError`, `ConflictError`, `ValidationError`, `ForbiddenError`, `UnauthorizedError` - **CSRF protection** — all mutation routes validate `origin` / `content-type` headers - **Ownership checks** — services expose `assertOwnership()` to verify the acting user

### Required Files
| File | Purpose | Template | |------|---------|----------| | `.env` | Backend & database config | `.env.example` | | `mobile/.env.local` | Mobile app build config | `mobile/.env.example` | | `mobile/google-services.json` | Android Firebase config | Generate from Firebase/Google Cloud | | `mobile/android/app/upload-keystore.jks` | Android signing key | Generate with `keytool` | | `mobile/google-play-service-account.json` | Google Play publisher account | Download from Google Play Console |
### Web App — `.env`
1. **Database** — PostgreSQL connection string. For local dev via docker-compose: ```env DATABASE_URL="postgresql://mixoguide:secret@localhost:5432/mixoguide" DIRECT_URL="postgresql://mixoguide:secret@localhost:5432/mixoguide" TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://mixoguide:secret@localhost:5432/mixoguide_test" ```
2. **NextAuth** — generates a secret and sets the auth URL: ```bash openssl rand -base64 32 # Generate NEXTAUTH_SECRET ``` ```env NEXTAUTH_SECRET="<output above>" NEXTAUTH_URL="http://localhost:3000" NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL="http://localhost:3000" ```
3. **Google OAuth** — [Guide](./OAUTH_SETUP.md) ```bash # 1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com/ # 2. Create a new project # 3. Enable "Google+ API" and "People API" # 4. Create OAuth 2.0 Web Application credentials # 5. Set authorized redirect URI: http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/google ``` ```env AUTH_GOOGLE_ID="<your-client-id>.apps.googleusercontent.com" AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET="<your-client-secret>" EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID="<same-client-id>.apps.googleusercontent.com" ```
4. **Image Upload** — Cloudinary (optional, but recommended) ```bash # 1. Sign up at https://cloudinary.com/ # 2. Copy your "Cloud Name", "API Key", and generate an "API Secret" ``` ```env CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME="<your-cloud-name>" CLOUDINARY_API_KEY="<your-api-key>" CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET="<your-api-secret>" ```
5. **Email** — Resend (for password reset emails) ```bash # 1. Sign up at https://resend.com/ # 2. Create an API key ``` ```env RESEND_API_KEY="re_<your-api-key>" ```
6. **Redis** — for rate limiting and sessions. Local docker-compose uses: ```env REDIS_PASSWORD="secret" REDIS_USERNAME="default" ```
7. **Other services** (optional): ```env # Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection) NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY="<your-site-key>" TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY="<your-secret-key>"
# PostHog (analytics) NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN="phc_..."
# Sentry (error tracking) EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN="https://..." ```
### Mobile App — `mobile/.env.local`
```bash cp mobile/.env.example mobile/.env.local ```
Fill in:
```env # Same Google Web client ID as backend EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID="<same-as-AUTH_GOOGLE_ID>"
# AdMob (optional) ADMOB_ANDROID_APP_ID="ca-app-pub-..." EXPO_PUBLIC_ADMOB_ANDROID_BANNER_UNIT_ID="ca-app-pub-..."
# Sentry (optional) EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN="https://..." ```
### Mobile App — `google-services.json`
Android requires a `google-services.json` file from Firebase:
1. Open [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/) 2. Create a project or select existing 3. Add Android app with package name: `com.mixoguide.app` 4. Download `google-services.json` and place in `mobile/` 5. The file must contain the same Web OAuth client ID as your `.env`
```bash # Verify it's there: ls -la mobile/google-services.json ```
### Mobile App — Android Signing Key
Required for production builds and Google Play submission:
```bash # Generate a new keystore (one-time, save the password securely!) keytool -genkey -v -keystore mobile/android/app/upload-keystore.jks \ -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \ -alias upload -storetype JKS
# For production, also grab the SHA-256 fingerprint: keytool -list -v -keystore mobile/android/app/upload-keystore.jks -alias upload
# Copy the SHA-256 fingerprint to .env: ANDROID_CERT_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS="AA:BB:CC:..." ```
**NEVER commit the `.jks` file to git** — it's in `.gitignore`.
### Mobile App — Google Play Service Account
For automated Play Store releases via Expo EAS:
1. Open [Google Play Console](https://play.google.com/console/) 2. Go to **Settings** → **API access** 3. Create a new Service Account in Google Cloud 4. Download the JSON key 5. Place it in `mobile/google-play-service-account.json` (local dev only, never commit) 6. Add to `.gitignore` if not already there
**NEVER commit the service account JSON to git** — it contains your private key.

## Deployment
The app ships as a **Docker image** (multi-stage build, ~50 MB runtime). The entrypoint runs `prisma migrate deploy` + optional seeding before starting the server.
**Local dev:** `docker-compose.yml` provides PostgreSQL 18 + MinIO (S3-compatible storage). MinIO buckets are auto-bootstrapped on first start.
**Production:** Self-hosted on Hetzner via [Coolify](https://coolify.io). See `COOLIFY_SETUP.sh` for the full provisioning guide.
### Production Ingredient Cleanup
After rebuilding/redeploying the app image, run the compiled production cleanup script from the production container. Preview the merge plan first:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --db ```
If the preview looks good, apply the merge:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --apply ```
Then verify that no configured duplicate ingredient rows remain:
```bash npm run db:ingredients:simplify:prod -- --db ```
The apply step rewires cocktail ingredients, pantry rows, main-alcohol references, barcodes, and derivatives before deleting duplicate ingredient rows.

## Conventions
- **One file = one responsibility** — Repository handles data, Service handles business logic, Route handles HTTP - **No Prisma in services** — always go through the repository layer - **No direct DB access from frontend** — all data flows through `/api/*` routes - **Always validate** with Zod before calling the service - **Typed errors** — `NotFoundError`, `ConflictError`, `ValidationError`, `ForbiddenError`, `UnauthorizedError` - **CSRF protection** — all mutation routes validate `origin` / `content-type` headers - **Ownership checks** — services expose `assertOwnership()` to verify the acting user
